subject: Approval request: compensation exception (equity refresh + accelerated merit) for IC - immediate retention risk
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Approval request: compensation exception (equity refresh + accelerated merit) for IC - immediate retention risk

Hi Laura and Rishi,

I need an exception approval for Elena Park (SDE II) — she’s a top contributor on Search infra and we just learned she’s fielding a strong counteroffer from a FAANG competitor. Open to sharing more detail offline, but I want to move fast to retain her.

Proposed package (manager recommendation):
- Merit increase: 12% base salary bump (out of band for SDE II; typical top-of-band is ~7–8%)
- One-time retention bonus: 10% of base, paid next payroll
- Equity refresh: 0.10% RSU grant (4-year vest with 1-yr cliff)
- Effective date: Dec 1, 2025 (onerous timeline; candidate likely decides within 2 weeks)

Attachments: comp-case-ELENA-2025.pdf (full justification), salary-bands-2025.xlsx, org-chart-Q4-2025.png.

Ask: Laura — can People Ops confirm whether the equity % and merit are approvable as an exception? Markus — need budget reallocation or exec sign-off if required. Rishi — please confirm you endorse and that this is the only retention path.

We’ve tried refresh window and spot bonus earlier this year; this is the only lever left to keep her. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Director, Search Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: comp-case-ELENA-2025.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval request: compensation exception (equity refresh + accelerated merit) for IC - immediate retention risk

Thanks Monica — I got the packet. Quick questions before I escalate to Compensation Committee:
1) Is Elena currently under any previous refresh schedule this cycle? (I need last grant date)
2) Manager calibration notes: can you provide 2–3 concrete outcomes from the last 6 months that justify +12% vs. standard range?
3) Proposed funding code and expected OPEX vs. headcount impact (finance will ask)

If we can get that by EOD Wednesday I’ll put this on the Committee agenda for Thursday morning. If the timeline is shorter, we can do an emergency review but will need Markus or an exec to authorize the exception threshold.

Also looping in People Ops approvals email (people_ops+approvals@acme-hr.com) for formal intake.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: salary-bands-2025.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval request: compensation exception (equity refresh + accelerated merit) for IC - immediate retention risk

Endorse — from my side this is high priority. Quick answers:
- Elena’s last grant: Apr 2024 (full-cycle RSU). She received a mid-cycle spot grant in Oct 2024; no scheduled refresh this cycle.
- Outcomes (last 6 months):
  * Led migration of KV cache to multi-tenant runtime; reduced 99th latency by 22% for our top routes
  * Drove incident response playbook that shortened recovery from 47m to 10m in 2 incidents
  * Mentored two new hires who are now shipping independent features
- Funding: we have a small vacancy savings bucket in Search infra (code: INFRA-Q4-RET) that can cover the one-time bonus and partial salary uplift; incremental OPEX for run-rate base increase is ~ $36k/year (I can provide exact).

If committee needs a slightly smaller base increase to meet band constraints, I’d prioritize equity % first (since retention signal there matters most).

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Engineering Manager, Search
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Approval request: compensation exception (equity refresh + accelerated merit) for IC - immediate retention risk

Laura — adding the calibration notes below and updating the budget code details as requested.

Manager calibration (short bullets attached in PDF):
- Performance: consistently rated "exceeds expectations" in last three checkpoints; peer feedback highlights leadership in firefights and cross-team coordination
- Business impact: changes to KV cache reduced infra costs and improved latency for three major customers -> demonstrable revenue protection
- Risk: counteroffer timeline is 7–10 days; we need final signoff or candidate will likely accept

Funding: INFRA-Q4-RET will cover: one-time bonus and first 6 months of incremental run-rate. Remaining run-rate will be folded into FY26 headcount plan; I will reallocate non-critical contractor spend to net-neutral.

Small table for committee (requested fields):
- Current base: $160,000
- Proposed base: $179,200 (12%)
- One-time bonus: $16,000 (10%)
- Equity: 0.10% approx.
- Run-rate delta: ~$36k/year

If the Committee needs a smaller base, my fallback is: 8% base + same equity (0.10%) + 10% bonus.

Happy to be on call for Thursday review.

Thanks,
Monica
Director, Search Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: comp-case-ELENA-2025.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval request: compensation exception (equity refresh + accelerated merit) for IC - immediate retention risk

Thanks for the thorough packet and quick turnaround. I approve an exception with the following adjustments and conditions:
1) Merit increase approved at 9% (not full 12%) due to band/market constraints — manager, please confirm acceptance with Elena and ask if the equity uplift is the priority.
2) One-time retention bonus 10% approved as requested.
3) Equity refresh approved at 0.08% RSUs, subject to final legal paperwork and normal RSU acceptance. People Ops to issue grant paperwork via DocuSign by EOD Friday; legal to confirm tax withholding approach for the country of record.
4) Funding: INFRA-Q4-RET covers one-time bonus and first 6 months of run-rate. Finance to update coding to INFRA-Q4-RET / GL-4302 and process in December payroll for base adjustment effective 12/1/2025.

Action items:
- Laura: please open the formal approval ticket (HR-2025-3421) and route to Comp Committee notes and Legal.
- Rishi: confirm with Monica if Elena accepts the 9% vs. your fallback. If they require 12%, escalate back to me and I will take to the executive exceptions panel.
- Monica: prep the offer language and be ready to extend by tomorrow if candidate timeline holds.

Quote: "We want to keep our top engineers — do the minimal but effective to retain." — approved.

Markus Klein
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
